description: A man in a dark wide-brimmed hat and dark work clothes leans from a dark bay horse with a white blaze, reaching across to a second bay horse with a saddle, while holding a leather saddle bag with pockets. A second man in a hat and waistcoat holds the second horse's bridle at the right. They stand in a dusty yard beside a dim log cabin with a glowing lantern on the wall, under a dark, dusky sky with flat plains on the left.
